claim: Which aldehyde A4B4-S3 was made from
locus_a: SI p.5: 'A mixture of 4-(dimethylamino)butanoic acid (30 mg, 228.7 umol), (Z)-1-isocyanooctadec-9-ene (81.09 mg, 228.7 umol) and 6-OXOHEXYL DODECANOATE (63.64 mg, 228.7 umol)' -- i.e. B3
locus_b: Three independent lines all give B4 (6-oxohexyl 2-hexyldecanoate): (i) the product's own IUPAC title on the same page ends '...7-oxoheptyl 2-HEXYLDECANOATE'; (ii) the MS formula C47H90N2O5 requires B4 (with B3 it would be C43H82N2O5); (iii) the printed masses give 81.09/228.7 = 354.57 g/mol = B4 and 63.64/228.7 = 278.27 = A4, i.e. the isocyanide and aldehyde MASSES ARE SWAPPED relative to the names beside them
why: Mass cannot see connectivity but it can see composition, and the authors' own mg/umol pairs are independent of the name typed beside them. The three masses are the right three for {S3, A4, B4} in any order (07_qc.json P4, n_lipids_matching_as_a_multiset = 6/6). Emitted with confidence = medium because the source paragraph is internally scrambled.

locus_b: The in-panel titles: D = 'Batch 1 (Classified by Headgroup)', G = 'Batch 2 (Classified by tail A)', H = 'Batch 3 (Classified by tail B)'; and the Results text 'In the third round of testing, all four LNPs ... were tested separately in mice (Fig. 2 F-H)'

why: The caption would make panel H a pooled mixture and nothing in this paper would be individually measured before Fig. 2K. The panel titles, the bar labels (B1-B4, i.e. H2A4B1-H2A4B4) and the Results text agree against it. This decides whether four rows exist at all.

claim: The mRNA dose in batches 1 and 2
locus_a: Fig. 2 caption: batch 1 = 0.32 mg/kg (16 LNPs per mouse); batch 2 = 0.08 mg/kg (4 LNPs per mouse)
locus_b: Methods 'In Vivo Batch Test': batch 1 = 0.25 mg/kg (16 LNPs); batch 2 = 0.8 mg/kg (4 LNPs)

why: Recorded because it adjudicates cleanly on a constraint neither states: the caption's pair gives EXACTLY 0.02 mg/kg per LNP in both rounds (0.32/16 = 0.08/4), while the Methods' pair gives 0.0156 and 0.200, a 12.8x change in per-LNP dose between two rounds that are compared to each other (07_qc.json V6). The caption is the self-consistent pair. Note 0.8 vs 0.08 is also a plausible decimal slip.

claim: The scale of Fig. 2K's y axis
locus_a: Its MINOR ticks are log-spaced: between the 0 and 1e7 labels they sit 45/72/90/105/117/127/136/143 px above 0, which is 151 px per decade (2,3,...,9 x 10^6 on a log scale)
locus_b: Its LABELLED ticks are linear: 0, 1e7, 2e7, 3e7 at 151.0 / 150.5 / 150.5 px apart, and the 4e7 tick drawn short at the axis break lands 0.25 px from where a linear fit on the other four predicts it. A log axis cannot carry a '0' tick at all
what_we_emitted: linear, calibrated on the labelled ticks only; 38 minor ticks ignored
why: The two readings differ by ~22x on a mid-panel bar, so this is the single largest value decision in the folder. It is settled inside panel K and nowhere else (07_qc.json P9). The agreement with Fig. 3I on H2A4B4 (1.04x) is reported as a consequence, never as the evidence.

claim: RETRACTED SUSPICION: that A4B4-S3 is library member H3A4B4 under a new name
locus_a: Both are C47H90N2O5 with MW 763.25, and if H3 were 4-(dimethylamino)butanoic acid (C6H13NO2, the S3 head) they would be the same molecule -- which would make the paper's 'rational redesign' a relabelling of a compound already in batch 1
locus_b: SI Fig. S3's drawn head group is N,N-diethylglycine, also C6H13NO2. A4B4-S3 is JBBSMSLXXPFXRD-MRCUWXFGSA-N; H3A4B4 is a different full InChIKey. They are isomers
why: KEPT IN THIS FILE SO IT IS NOT RE-RAISED. The formula, the exact mass and the MW are identical and cannot distinguish them; only the drawn structure does. This is the 'mass cannot see connectivity' case in its cheapest form.

locus_a: Results: 'we also synthesized H2A4-Ole and H2A4-Butyl based on the previous structures'; it is drawn in Fig. 2I and bar-charted in Fig. 2K as its own entity
locus_b: H2A4-Ole = H2 + A4 + olealdehyde = B2, i.e. library member H2A4B2. Same full InChIKey, WNUMPPMZXDNLCE-WRBBJXAJSA-N (07_qc.json P7)

why: H2A4-Butyl IS genuinely new (2-butyloctanoate is not among B1-B4). H2A4-Ole is not: it is one of the 144, already pooled into batch 1 (H2) and batch 2 (A4) and already measured as B2 in batch 3. The paper's own count of what it made is 148 names over 147 molecules.

claim: The mass convention in the SI characterisation
locus_a: Nine building blocks printed as 'MW calc'd for <neutral formula> (M + H+)' -- but 8 of 9 values are the NEUTRAL MONOISOTOPIC mass and 0 of 9 are [M+H]+ (07_qc.json P5)
locus_b: Six lipids printed as '[M+H]+ calc'd' -- four (the H2A4* set) are AVERAGE MW + 1.008, two (A4B4-S3/S4) are MONOISOTOPIC [M+H]+ (07_qc.json P6)
what_we_emitted: nothing; no value depends on it
why: Recorded because checking against a single convention would make 4 of 6 lipids, or 2 of 6, look wrong. All six fit one of the two conventions to within 0.05 Da. The one block that fits neither is 6-oxohexyl 2-butyloctanoate, printed 299.47 where the cation is 299.26 and the reported 'found' is 299.27 -- a digit slip in the calc'd value only.
